instruments.legal_description_raw: Statewide conveyance of the grantor's real estate, tracts, parcels, franchises, gas plants, compressor stations, pipe lines, rights-of-way, easements, equipment, and related utility property. The attached schedules span many Oklahoma counties. The visible Beckham County real-estate entries include the North Half of the Southwest Quarter of the Southwest Quarter of Section 21, Township 9 North, Range 23 West, containing 20 acres, subject to a previously conveyed undivided 5/8 royalty oil-and-gas mineral interest; an undivided mineral interest in the Southwest Quarter of the Southeast Quarter of Section 21, Township 9 North, Range 23 West; and an undivided 2/60th interest in the West Half of the Southwest Quarter of Section 20, Township 9 North, Range 23 West, subject to the stated lease and mortgage. No Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West call was found in the complete instrument.
instruments.prior_references: Schedules cite numerous recorded deeds, leases, mortgages, and rights-of-way by county book and page.
instruments.subject_to: Visible schedules preserve stated outstanding royalty/mineral interests, oil-and-gas leases, mortgages, and recorded easements affecting particular scheduled properties.
instruments.material_title_notes: Complete replacement for the partial Batch 03 B03-G041 record. The instrument begins on 0149.jpg, continues through the statewide property and utility schedules, is executed by Consolidated Gas Service Company on 0169.jpg, and ends before the separate warranty deed beginning on the same image.
instruments.interest_before: Consolidated Gas Service Company held the scheduled real estate, utility systems, franchises, easements, rights-of-way, equipment, and related assets.
instruments.interest_after: Consolidated Gas Utilities Corporation received the scheduled property and assets, subject to the instrument's stated exceptions, recorded burdens, and warranty provisions.
instruments.relevance_to_diversified: No Diversified party appears, no Section 32-11N-25W property was found in the completed schedule, and the reviewed record supplies no defensible chain link to Diversified.
instruments.assumptions: The schedule contains hundreds of compressed entries; the conclusion that no target call appears is based on direct page review plus enhanced OCR searches, not on an inference from county headings alone.
instruments.full_title: Indenture Conveying Utility Property and Assets

instruments.grantor: Joseph Woodruff, a widower; O. T. Walker and Myrtle A. Walker, husband and wife; and Harry Riley, a single man
instruments.legal_description_raw: North Half of the Northwest Quarter and Southwest Quarter of the Northwest Quarter and Northeast Quarter of the Southwest Quarter of Section Thirteen (13), Township Nine (9) North of Range Twenty-three (23) West, 200 acres
instruments.legal_description_normalized: N/2 NW/4, SW/4 NW/4, and NE/4 SW/4 of Section 13, Township 9 North, Range 23 West
instruments.subject_to: Mortgage of $750.00 to R. E. Malin's Bank, assumed and agreed to be paid by the grantee
instruments.material_title_notes: The deed begins below the completed B03-G041 indenture on 0169.jpg and ends with the individual grantor signatures at the foot of that image. The next source image jumps to recorded page 470 and begins with an acknowledgment by a corporate president; it is not a continuation of this deed. The typed acreage does not arithmetically match the listed aliquots and is preserved as written.
instruments.interest_before: The named grantors held the conveyed fee interest, subject to the stated bank mortgage.
instruments.interest_after: H. B. Jones received the conveyed fee interest and assumed the stated $750 mortgage.
instruments.relevance_to_diversified: Different section, township, and range; no Diversified party or supported chain link appears.
instruments.assumptions: The visible deed states 200 acres, while the listed aliquots ordinarily total 160 acres; neither value was silently corrected. No matching acknowledgment page is present in the source sequence.

instruments.other_capacities: O. C. Griffith, president of an unidentified corporation; Myrtle Caraway, notary public
instruments.material_title_notes: Only the concluding corporate acknowledgment is visible at the top of 0170.jpg. It certifies that O. C. Griffith, as president, executed the preceding instrument as the free and voluntary act and deed of the corporation. The opening instrument page is absent from this source sequence; the supplemental mortgage begins below it. A marginal certification references payment of a mortgage but is too compressed to tie safely to a named instrument.
instruments.relevance_to_diversified: No Diversified party, target legal description, or defensible chain link is visible in this acknowledgment-only fragment.
instruments.assumptions: No party name, instrument type, book, or legal description was inferred from the corporate acknowledgment alone.

instruments.grantee: Manufacturers Trust Company and James F. McNamara, Trustees
instruments.mortgagee: Manufacturers Trust Company and James F. McNamara, Trustees
instruments.other_capacities: Manufacturers Trust Company and James F. McNamara, trustees for holders of First Mortgage and Collateral 6% Gold Bonds
instruments.legal_description_raw: Among the statewide real estate, pipe-line, transmission-line, right-of-way, easement, plant, equipment, and lease schedules, the Beckham County-Enid line schedule on recorded page 477 lists: B. E. Maddoux — W/2 NW/4 of Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West; and G. A. Crook — NE/4 of Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West.
instruments.legal_description_normalized: W/2 NW/4 and NE/4 of Section 32, Township 11 North, Range 25 West
instruments.prior_references: Original Indenture dated June 1, 1928; supplemental indentures dated July 1, 1931, August 31, 1931, and October 1, 1933; trustee deed dated October 14, 1935; deed from Consolidated Gas Service Company dated November 30, 1935.
instruments.subject_to: The supplemental mortgage is governed by the Original Indenture and prior supplements and secures outstanding First Mortgage and Collateral 6% Gold Bonds stated in the opening recitals as $8,265,000 principal amount.
instruments.material_title_notes: The instrument starts below the corporate acknowledgment fragment B04-G002 on 0170.jpg. Target Section 32 entries are visible in the Beckham County-Enid line schedule on 0177.jpg. Pages 0170-0200 contain only part of this very long supplemental indenture; visual inspection of 0201.jpg confirms continuation and 0201.jpg is not marked reviewed.
instruments.interest_before: Consolidated Gas Utilities Corporation held the newly acquired scheduled property and rights, including the listed Section 32 pipeline rights-of-way/easements.
instruments.interest_after: The scheduled property and rights were added to the collateral conveyed and mortgaged to Manufacturers Trust Company and James F. McNamara, Trustees, for the secured bondholders; this is a lien/security conveyance, not a fee transfer to an operating successor.
instruments.relevance_to_diversified: The instrument is relevant to the target tract because it expressly includes Section 32-11N-25W pipeline right-of-way/easement interests. No Diversified party appears, and no reviewed document supports treating the 1935 utility mortgage as a Diversified ownership-chain link.
instruments.assumptions: The W/2 NW/4 reading for B. E. Maddoux is supported by enhanced visual review and OCR but remains compressed in the source schedule. The instrument ending, final acknowledgment, and any later target references lie outside this batch.
